output.headline: Harbour City’s Press Wins 4‑1
output.text: Harbour City’s high‑press, quick‑combination style dominated after an early Ironvale block (e0041). A 22‑m pass from Hiro Tanaka to Luca Romero (e0143) sparked the first chance, but Zeke Mbeki’s 6.3 m, 96.1 km/h strike gave Ironvale a 1‑0 lead (e0599,e0600). Harbour City responded with Leo Marchetti’s 15.2 m goal (e0999) and Dani Kowalski’s 13.5 m finish (e1223), turning momentum (m074). Kowalski added two more strikes, the last a 2.5 m, 71.9 km/h winner (e1725), sealing a 4‑1 win. Harbour’s PPDA 8.5 and 84% pass accuracy limited Ironvale’s deep block, while Kowalski’s 3 goals (xG 1.17) made him the standout.
